Printed edition: The battle of Tsu-shima between the Japanese and Russian fleets, fought on 27th May 1905, London J. Murray, 1912, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/battleoftsushima00semeuoft. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 100%, 94%, 73% of their four-word runs in the scan's text.
